---
applyTo: "evidence/**"
---
# Evidence records

Applies to traceability and AI activity records. Never insert secrets, real customer material, or unnecessary personal data. Preserve exact commands/outcomes and mark unrun/skipped explicitly. AI output is a draft; record human owner, decision, corrections, unresolved questions, and residual risk. Validate IDs, references, and mandatory fields with `python scripts/validate_traceability.py`.
